exposure: Pregnant women with kidney transplantation <5 years after transplantation
Pregnant women with kidney transplantation ≥5 years after transplantation
intervals after transplantation (<5 years vs. ≧5 years)
outcome: Neonatal outcomes (premature delivery, low birth weight, mode of birth, small for gestational age, respiratory distress syndrome, intraventricular hemorrhage, atrial septal defects, bronchopulmonary dysplasia)
finding: While most pregnancies after kidney transplantation were successful, the incidence of maternal and neonatal complications remained high, and these outcomes were not significantly different between women who conceived at <5 years versus ≥5 years after transplantation.
mod_finding: The study found that different intervals after kidney transplantation did not have a significant impact on pregnancy outcomes, including mode of birth.
gest_age: Average gestational age for live births was 33.8 ± 2.2 weeks
